execution.raw_text:
```json
{
  "up": "Return all molecules reported in the specified document. For each molecule, provide the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, maximum clinical phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES. Sort the results by the molecule ChEMBL ID in ascending order.",
  "select": [
    "molecule_chembl_id",
    "molecule_name",
    "max_phase",
    "molecule_type",
    "canonical_smiles"
  ],
  "source": [
    "docs",
    "compound_records",
    "molecule_dictionary",
    "compound_structures"
  ],
  "join": [
    "docs.doc_id = compound_records.doc_id",
    "compound_records.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno",
    "molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno"
  ],
  "filter": [
    "docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1122023'"
  ],
  "sort": [
    "molecule_chembl_id ASC"
  ]
}
```
